args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with a ~18% error rate after the latest deploy. SRE agent rolled back checkout-api in all production regions from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. Rollback confirmed rolled out to us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Please investigate the v2.3.1 regression before attempting redeploy.
args.title: checkout-api rollback: v2.3.1 failing health checks

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

- **Confirmed the problem**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — across all regions. Post-rollback status is **healthy** in all regions with the error rate back down to 0.2%.
- **Opened incident INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, describing the v2.3.1 health-check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 should be investigated for the regression before any redeploy attempt.
